info.name: User Limit Guard
info.summary: Caps total user accounts at the NC_USER_LIMIT environment variable.
info.description: Blocks new user creation -- from the web UI, occ user:add, and the provisioning API alike, since all three share the same createUser() code path -- once the account count reaches the limit set by the NC_USER_LIMIT environment variable. Also shows the number of remaining free user slots in the bottom-left corner of the Settings > Users administration page. Leave NC_USER_LIMIT unset to disable enforcement entirely.
info.author: Anirban
